required_consumer_behavior: Render workflow, acknowledgement, reconciliation, source-confirmed and dead-letter states as distinct API evidence.
Never replay a dead letter from the browser; replay remains operator/reconciliation gated and must return a new receipt reference.
Treat stale workflow versions, lost leases and cross-tenant reads as fail-closed outcomes.
Do not represent provider acknowledgement as business completion or a locally rendered state as authoritative truth.
acceptance_proof_needed: exact UI and API SHAs and luzione-workflow-delivery/v0.1
source-confirmed state only after authoritative readback evidence
known_limitations: No UI repository test or operator workflow was executed.
No worker, provider adapter or HTTP mutation route was activated.
The migration was proven only in disposable local Postgres and was not applied to managed or production infrastructure.
